channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Oil, gas & power in Indian markets. Today: mixed (−0.1).

item.title: [+1] RBI adds 20% rupee deposit on FX derivatives over $2 million in its strongest rupee defence since 2013
item.description:
Banks must park rupees equal to 20% of the notional value of such trades with the RBI. This adds to the oil-company dollar window from Monday, a $5 million cap on unhedged FX derivatives and a ban on rebooking. Escalating defence.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Oil importers' dollar needs covered

Why it matters: Making speculative dollar bets costly and removing oil importers' demand should steady the rupee and imported inflation, but it raises hedging costs and keeps draining reserves.

Market gauges: Rupee +2, Foreign investor flows −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Iran says it has again shut the Strait of Hormuz; shipping slows and a tanker is hit and set on fire
item.description:
The UK maritime agency reported a projectile strike and fire on a tanker overnight. This undercuts Friday's calm after the US pledged no strikes before the midterms. Escalating.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Gulf supply squeezed

Why it matters: Another closure claim on the route for much of India's crude and LNG keeps the oil risk premium, freight and insurance high, working against the RBI's rupee defence.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] US signs a deal to buy about 5 million tonnes of Russian diesel; EU says it funds Russia's war
item.description:
The move comes weeks after the US penalised India over Russian oil purchases. Separately, the US warned Ukraine over strikes on Russian refineries. New.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Lower diesel export margins

Why it matters: More Russian diesel reaching the market can ease global diesel prices, trimming Indian refiners' export margins; it also weakens the US case for penalising India's Russian oil buying.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
